_comment: Series manifest for the 21-book Eliminoid set. Phase 1: every book uses the one canonical 20-rule chain (config/chain.json), each with its own seed so the grids differ. The Capstone (book 21) builds identically in iteration 1 because all books share the chain, so its diagonal (Rule N = Book N's Rule N) IS the canonical chain. Per-book 'answer' overrides and the Mystery/acrostic plant plan arrive in later phases (see SERIES_IMPLEMENTATION.md).
